blocks.name: feature
blocks.decorate_shape: Classifies cells (not rows) into .feature-image/.feature-copy and flattens them into one row; publishes the image's real ratio as --feature-image-ratio; decorateCta().
blocks.content_contract: Image cell + copy cell, in either order, any row arrangement.

blocks.name: icon-feature
blocks.decorate_shape: Container: one row per item; resolves an icon token to a span.icon, moves copy into .icon-feature-copy, fixes desktop column count via data-columns.
blocks.content_contract: Per item: icon cell + copy cell.
blocks.verified: 1440 content x=163 w=432, rule x=720, band padding 104

blocks.name: product-cards
blocks.decorate_shape: Container: one row per card; classifies image/copy/links/accent cells; cards become ul>li; derives aria-labels for repeated link text.
blocks.content_contract: Per card: image cell, copy cell (eyebrow + heading + body), links cell, accent token cell.

blocks.name: cards
blocks.decorate_shape: Boilerplate: rows to ul>li, cells classed cards-card-image / cards-card-body.
blocks.content_contract: Per card: image cell + text cell.

blocks.name: hero
blocks.decorate_shape: Splits cells into panes (.hero-image/.hero-panel) as direct block children; explicit CSS order so panel always leads.
blocks.content_contract: Image cell + copy cell, either arrangement.
